gaps.next_text: All our enemies have fallen before us.

cues.text: Five white beams radiate upwards against a deep red background.
Wired to glowing pillars, the scarred, shirtless emperor clenches his fist. Darkness.

beats.note: Five white beams radiate upwards against a solid red background.
The beams shine from behind a white, classical building. A man in black stands on a balcony above an army of red silhouettes.
The man on the balcony, bald with a beard, wears a black coat with a fur collar.
He raises a fist to his chest as white petals fall around him.
The image glitches and transitions to a dark laboratory.
The man, now shirtless, scarred, and muscular, stands between two glowing pillars. Tubes connect his torso and arms to the machinery. Scientists observe him.
